passage.title: The Founding of the People's Republic of China Anniversary

script.speaker: 播音员
script.text: 各位听众大家好，欢迎收听新闻播报。

script.speaker: 播音员
script.text: 今天是十月一日，是中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议开幕的纪念日。

script.speaker: 播音员
script.text: 一九四九年十月一日，中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议在北京隆重召开。

script.speaker: 播音员
script.text: 会议通过了《中国人民政治协商会议共同纲领》，选举产生了中央人民政府委员会，并决定以五星红旗为中华人民共和国国旗，以《义勇军进行曲》为国歌，将首都从北平改名为北京。

script.speaker: 播音员
script.text: 今天，我们庆祝建国七十四周年。

script.speaker: 播音员
script.text: 政府将举办各种庆祝活动，包括阅兵式、文艺演出和群众游行，以纪念这个重要的日子。

script.speaker: 播音员
script.text: 感谢您的收听，祝大家节日快乐！

items.stem: What is the main idea of this news brief?

The Chinese government celebrates the founding of the People's Republic of China
The Chinese government announces a new policy for the People's Republic of China
The Chinese government discusses the history of the People's Republic of China
items.explanation: The main idea is that the Chinese government celebrates the founding of the People's Republic of China. This is shown by the phrase 庆祝建国 in the text.

items.stem: When was the People's Republic of China founded?
items.explanation: The text states that the People's Republic of China was founded on October 1, 1949, with the phrase 一九四九年十月一日.

items.stem: What does 庆祝 mean in this context?
items.explanation: In this context, 庆祝 means "to celebrate." The text uses this word to describe what the Chinese government is doing for the founding of the People's Republic of China.
